title: A One-Day Workshop Timeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A horizontal timeline from 8:30 to 3:30 built from the chapter's sample agenda, with block widths in proportion to time and a token for what teachers leave with.

educational.topic: The order of a one-day OER reviewer workshop and what teachers leave with
learningObjectives: The learner will order the blocks of the one-day workshop and explain why the rubric comes before calibration and checking comes before improving.
prerequisites: The sample agenda from [Chapter 19](../../chapters/19-training-certifying-reviewers/index.md) and the [Sample One-Day Schedule](../../workshops/sample-one-day-schedule.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What do teachers leave with from this block?
commonMisconceptions: A workshop is a lecture followed by a survey
The order of the blocks does not matter
assessmentOpportunities: Which block comes right after calibration and the break?
What do teachers leave with from the improvement challenge?
Why does the rubric come before calibration?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Numbered markers
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
